Join Siemens Energy – Powering the Future At Siemens Energy, we are driving the energy transition and addressing the greatest challenge of our generation: reducing emissions while increasing energy supply. With over 150 years of innovation, our dedicated team of 100,000 professionals across 90 countries is at the forefront of electrifying the world.
A Snapshot of Your Day As a Working Student within the NextGen Accounting team, you will create digital learning and communication materials that support stakeholder engagement and project visibility, furthermore you will contribute to process documentation and workflow modelling activities across the accounting function, helping to improve process clarity and operational efficiency. How Youll Make an Impact Create and edit engaging storytelling and instructional videos that communicate accounting responsibilities, departmental activities, and key accounting projects in an easy-to-understand format. Develop visual media assets, animations, and other multimedia content, while managing publication on internal platforms and ensuring alignment with company branding and quality standards. Support the documentation and modelling of accounting processes by creating current-state process maps and workflow diagrams using standard process modelling methodologies available in Siemens Energy (BIC Process House). Collaborate with accounting subject matter experts to gather information, validate process flows, and ensure documentation accuracy. Develop and maintain clear process documentation and reference materials to support knowledge sharing, onboarding, and internal training activities. Assist in managing a centralized repository of process models and documentation, ensuring content remains accurate, organized, and easily accessible. What You Bring Currently enrolled in a Bachelors or Masters degree program in Business Administration, Finance, Accounting, Information Systems, Marketing or a related field. No formal work experience required; relevant university project work or a portfolio demonstrating skills in process mapping or video creation is a plus. Strong attention to detail and accuracy, good analytical and problem-solving skills Very good knowledge of MS Office (PowerPoint, Word, Outlook) Strong communication skills in English, both written and spoken. Strong interest in both business process analysis and digital media production, with a willingness to learn accounting processes and concepts, familiarity with process modelling tools (e.g. Visio, ARIS or similar) and video editing software (e.g. Vyond which is in use in Siemens Energy or similar) is a plus. About the Team Our Corporate and Global Functions are essential in driving the companys strategic initiatives and ensuring operational excellence across various departments, business areas, and regions. These roles support our vision to become the most valued energy technology company in the world. As part of our team, you contribute to our vision by shaping the global energy transition, partnering with our internal and external stakeholders, and conducting business responsibly and in compliance with legal requirements and regulations Who is Siemens Energy? At Siemens Energy, we are more than just an energy technology company. With ~100,000 dedicated employees in more than 90 countries, we develop the energy systems of the future, ensuring that the growing energy demand of the global community is met reliably and sustainably. The technologies created in our research departments and factories drive the energy transition and provide the base for one sixth of the worlds electricity generation. Our global team is committed to making sustainable, reliable, and affordable energy a reality by pushing the boundaries of what is possible. We uphold a 150-year legacy of innovation that encourages our search for people who will support our focus on decarbonization, new technologies, and energy transformation. Find out how you can make a difference at Siemens Energy: https://www.siemens-energy.com/employeevideo Our Office Siemens Energys location in One Cotroceni Park is more than just an office space - its a hub for a vibrant and thriving community. Nestled in the heart of Bucharest, this urban development is the perfect place to work, surrounded by green spaces, shopping destinations, and everything the city center has to offer. And with the Academia Militara subway station just a 3-minute walk away, getting around the city has never been easier. Our Commitment to Diversity Lucky for us, we are not all the same. Through diversity, we generate power. We run on inclusion and our combined creative energy is fueled by over 130 nationalities. Siemens Energy celebrates character ??? no matter what ethnic background, gender, age, religion, identity, or disability. We energize society, all of society, and we do not discriminate based on our differences.
